stem: Which sentence from “A Baseball School for Big-League Dreamers” best supports the main idea of the article?

options.label: A
options.text: Tuition, room and board here for the combined academic and sports program is about $70,000 a year.

options.label: B
options.text: Most players here won't ever put on a big-league uniform, but they come to IMG trying to find and reach their potential.

options.label: C
options.text: He remembers being fascinated by how the players and coaches talked and how fans reacted to the game.

options.label: D
options.text: Ketch doesn’t think about the numbers.
